svg.text: a5984 stepper driver · circuit notes and limits
Exact notes retained from source-bound annotated reference; diagram and hardware acceptance remain OPEN.
Three independent A5984GLP drivers share active-low ENABLE. Header pin 2 is independently unconnected on C1 and C4.
RV1–RV3 (50 kΩ) adjust REF through 33.2 kΩ series resistors; ITripMAX = VREF / (8 × RS). Fitted sense values require
D0/1/2 MS1–3 solder / 0603 straps select microstepping. Source 0 Ω values do not establish actual fitted state.
Four board mounts are grounded; four 60 mm underside-fan mounts are isolated. No fan power connector is shown.
